Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ingestion

Class ArticleContentEnricher

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ingestion.ArticleContentEnricher
@Component public class ArticleContentEnricher extends Object
Enriches articles that have no meaningful body text by following their URL and scraping the page content via jsoup.

Many RSS feeds and news aggregators provide only a title and link with no body text (or a trivial one-line description). This enricher bridges that gap: for each article whose bodyText is null, blank, or shorter than MIN_USEFUL_LENGTH characters, it fetches the linked page, extracts the main content area using the same semantic CSS selectors as WebPageHarvester (main, article, [role=main] with <body> fallback), and returns a new NewsArticle with the enriched body text.

Articles that already have sufficient body text are passed through unchanged. Fetch failures are logged and the article is returned as-is (the downstream filter can then decide whether to keep or drop it).

Body text is truncated to MAX_BODY_LENGTH characters to prevent excessively large documents from consuming storage or context.

    • hasUsefulBody

      public boolean hasUsefulBody(NewsArticle article)
      Always returns false so that every article gets enriched with full page content from its URL. Previously gated by a 50-char minimum threshold, but now all articles are enriched to capture complete article text for the vector database archive.
      Parameters:
      article - The article to check.
      Returns:
      always false — all articles are enriched
